components.description: Transformer-style encoder block (containing Multi-Head Attention, Layer Norm, Position-Wise Feed-Forward, residual paths) that is repeated N times.

components.description: Final dense network that maps pooled features to output logits.

components.name: User Interaction Vector (x_{u,:})
components.description: Binary vector indicating which items the user has interacted with.

components.name: Disentangle Encoder Layer
components.description: Neural encoder that maps the interaction vector to parameters of a user-specific latent distribution.

components.name: μ_u
components.description: Mean vector output by the encoder for user u.

components.name: σ_u
components.description: Standard-deviation vector output by the encoder for user u.

components.name: Latent Distribution N(μ_u, σ_u)
components.description: User-dependent Gaussian from which the latent code is sampled.

components.name: Latent Variable z_u
components.description: Sampled latent user representation.

components.description: Regularisation term that enforces the latent code to stay close to the prior.

components.name: Prior Distribution N(0, σ₀²I)

components.description: Neural decoder that reconstructs the interaction vector from z_u.

components.name: Step 1: Input terminals
components.description: Input convex hulls of {q0,k} and {qm,k} which serve as terminals C0 and C1.

components.name: Step 2: Construct order pairs
components.description: Generate all ordered pairs (q0,k, qm,k) with mapping f, forming the set P.

components.name: Step 3: Find paths
components.description: Apply a path-planning algorithm to find every path connecting each ordered pair (q0, qm).

components.name: Step 4: Optimize trajectories
components.description: Solve individual optimization problems for every path to obtain optimal trajectories.

components.name: Step 5: Construct optimal virtual tube
components.description: Form the convex hull of all optimal trajectories, yielding an optimal virtual tube.

components.name: Step 6: Output infinite optimal trajectories
components.description: Produce infinitely many optimal trajectories via linear interpolation inside the virtual tube.

text_labels.text: Input convex hull of {q0,k} and convex hull of {qm,k} as the terminals C0 and C1.
The order pairs (q0,k, qm,k) in P are constructed by f. Then all order pairs in P are obtained.
All paths for order pairs (q0, qm) are found by a path planning algorithm.
The optimal trajectories for all paths are generated by solving optimization problems respectively.
The optimal virtual tube is the convex hull of all optimal trajectories.
Infinite optimal trajectories are generated by linear interpolation.
